subtitle: Lightweight Go + Gin REST API Boilerplate
description: A simple, lightweight RESTful API boilerplate built with Go and the Gin framework. Serves as a starting point for new web services with built-in middleware, structured logging, and rate limiting already wired up.

architectureHighlights.title: Boilerplate-first Design
architectureHighlights.description: Ships with routing, middleware, and error handling already scaffolded so new services can start with business logic on day one.

architectureHighlights.title: Configurable via Environment
architectureHighlights.description: Server port, log rotation, rate limits, and API token are all driven by environment variables.

architectureHighlights.title: Built-in Log Viewer
architectureHighlights.description: A password-protected /logs endpoint renders recent log output through an HTML template for quick debugging.

routes.description: Sample authenticated endpoint that responds with a greeting.
Loads an HTML template displaying recent logging information.

setupAndRun.step: Clone the repository and install dependencies
setupAndRun.command: git clone git@github.com:chetuachar/gin-api-template.git && cd gin-api-template && go mod tidy

setupAndRun.description: Set SERVER_PORT, SELF_API_TOKEN, LOG_LEVEL, REQ_RATE_LIMIT and related log/rate-limit settings.
